text: @ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui 是面向 DSH Web 对话界面的 Generative UI 插件：它让 agent 在回复中输出 generative-ui 围栏，将其中的自包含 HTML 提取出来，并在对应消息下方显示为可交互卡片。插件通过 system prompt 提示围栏格式，再由客户端事件累加器识别完整工件和正在生成的片段，使用 iframe 展示，并提供随宿主主题变化的样式变量与高度自适应。适合在对话里呈现小型看板、演示、原型或计算器。需按说明将插件加入 profile bundle 并重启桌面 App；运行实现不声明 API key 或外部服务。

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui renders generative-ui HTML fences from DSH replies as interactive cards under the matching turn. The web client supports streaming content and adaptive sizing and themes. Add it to the profile bundle and restart the desktop app.
想让 AI 在 DSH 回复里生成能直接点击操作的小组件。
DSH 对话里的 HTML 代码块能不能变成可交互卡片？
Show a small interactive HTML artifact beneath the DSH response that created it.
@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui 的功能「对话内渲染工件」：客户端从 assistant 消息中识别 generative-ui 围栏，在对应轮次下方显示 HTML 交互卡片；围栏未闭合时也会展示正在生成的内容。

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · dsh-generative-ui：Let the AI output **interactive HTML components** (Generative UI) directly in the DSH chat flow. The agent writes a fenced code block in its reply: ````md ```generative-ui 0 ``` ````

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · dsh-generative-ui：The plugin extracts every artifact from that turn and renders it as a sandboxed
card below the message: an `<iframe sandbox="allow-scripts">` (no same-origin)
— the artifact is fully interactive, but can never touch the host page,
cookies, or local storage.

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · Design：- **Pure client-side: no backend, no storage.** Artifacts live in the session
  message text — the session is the store; there is no second copy of state
  and nothing to sync.
- The host half does one thing: broadcast the fenced-block convention to every
  agent via `systemPrompt.section`.
- The browser half uses a `uiConversation.events` accumulator to extract
  artifacts from `assistant/message` events (the same turn-accumulator pattern
  as dsh-taskboard), projects them onto the turn location, and renders the
  cards through the `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot.
- Adaptive height: a bootstrap injected into each artifact reports its height
  to the parent via ResizeObserver + postMessage; cards are clamped between
  120–600px and scroll internally beyond that.

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · Layout constraints：An artifact is a bare iframe document: no font, no spacing reset, no surface. Every artifact document therefore gets a design system inlined into `<head>` (`DESIGN_SYSTEM_CSS`), so constrained generation is enforced at runtime rather than merely requested in the prompt:

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · Layout constraints：- **Separate regions with surfaces, not borders.** `--gui-surface-1/2/3` is a three-step surface ramp; `--gui-tint` / `--gui-tint-strong` are accent washes.
- **Three type sizes, no more.** `--gui-fs-title`(18) / `--gui-fs-body`(14) / `--gui-fs-caption`(12); hierarchy comes from weight and `--gui-fg-dim`, not from 1.08-ratio size steps.
- **Spacing and radius are tokens only.** `--gui-gap`(12) / `--gui-pad`(16), radius `--gui-radius`(12) / `--gui-radius-sm`(8); chips stay fully round.
- **Outer spacing is reset.** `html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}` keeps artifacts flush with the message column; inner blocks own their spacing.
- **A typography baseline.** System font stack, 14px/1.7, an 11–17px size scale — no browser-default serif.
- **Utilities**: `.gui-stack` `.gui-section` `.gui-section--tint` `.gui-card` `.gui-tint` `.gui-chip` `.gui-chip--on` `.gui-label` `.gui-title` `.gui-desc` `.gui-note` `.gui-grid`.
- **Interaction and motion built in.** `button` ships with the primary style, `:active` scale, `:focus-visible` ring and 44px touch height; motion stays on `transform`/`opacity` under 200ms with `--gui-eas
@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · Layout constraints：The same rules travel to the model as text in `GENERATIVE_UI_GUIDANCE`.

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · dsh-generative-ui：让 AI 在 DSH 对话流里直接输出**可交互的 HTML 组件**（Generative UI）。 agent 在回复正文里写一段 fenced code block： ````md ```generative-ui 0 ``` ```` 插件把这一轮回答里的所有工件提取出来，在该轮消息下方渲染成沙箱卡片： 内嵌 `

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 设计：- **纯客户端，零后端，零存储。** 工件就活在会话消息文本里——会话在，工件就在；
  没有第二份状态，没有同步问题。
- 宿主半边只做一件事：通过 `systemPrompt.section` 把围栏约定广播给每个 agent。
- 浏览器半边用 `uiConversation.events` 事件累加器从 `assistant/message` 事件里
  提取工件（与 dsh-taskboard 的 turn 累加器同款模式），投影到 turn location，
  再由 `conversation.chat.turnTail` slot 渲染卡片。
- 高度自适应：注入每个工件的 bootstrap 用 ResizeObserver 向 parent
  postMessage 报告高度，卡片夹在 120–600px 之间，超出内部滚动。
@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 版面约束：工件是裸的 iframe 文档：没有字体、没有间距重置、没有底色。插件的每个工件文档都会在 `<head>` 注入一份设计系统（`DESIGN_SYSTEM_CSS`），把「有约束地生成」落到运行时，而不是只写在提示词里：

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 版面约束：- **分层靠底色，不靠描边。** `--gui-surface-1/2/3` 是由浅到深的三层底面，`--gui-tint` / `--gui-tint-strong` 是强调色淡底；分区不再用 1px border。
- **字号只留三档。** `--gui-fs-title`(18) / `--gui-fs-body`(14) / `--gui-fs-caption`(12)，上下文层级靠字重与 `--gui-fg-dim`，不再堆 11/12.5/13.5 这类 1.08 比例的字号差。
- **间距与圆角只有令牌。** `--gui-gap`(12) / `--gui-pad`(16)，圆角 `--gui-radius`(12) / `--gui-radius-sm`(8)；chips 用全圆。
- **外边距强制归零。** `html,body{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}`，工件与对话正文左对齐，间距由内层区块承担。
- **自带排版基线。** 系统字体栈、14px/1.7、11–17px 字号档位，避免落到浏览器默认衬线字体。
- **工具类**：`.gui-stack` `.gui-section` `.gui-section--tint` `.gui-card` `.gui-tint` `.gui-chip` `.gui-chip--on` `.gui-label` `.gui-title` `.gui-desc` `.gui-note` `.gui-grid`。
- **交互态与动效内置。** `button` 自带主按钮样式、`:active` 缩放、`:focus-visible` 焦点环，触控设备最小 44px；动效只用 `transform`/`opacity`，≤200ms，`--gui-ease` 缓动，并带 `prefers-reduced-motion` 兜底。
- **审计**：`auditArtifactSource(source)` 返回违反项（`border` / `shadow` / `gradient` / `blur` / `body-spacing` / `comment` / `em-dash` / `buzzword` / `pure-color`），只提示不拦截。
@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 版面约束：同一套规则以文字形式写进 systemPrompt（`GENERATIVE_UI_GUIDANCE`），模型在生成时即可遵守。

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:<本目录>

@ttmouse/dsh-generative-ui README · 开发：```sh
npm install && npm run build       # 产出 lib/client.js + lib/index.mjs
npm test                           # 单测 + e2e（无头 Chromium）
npm run screenshot                 # 用真实客户端重新生成 screenshot.png
```
